svg.title: HE-01.2 animated: plant run F-01b
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping animation of plant run F-01b for HE-01.2: the Corolla's lateral offset on a straightened road from 1 s before the fault to 4.6 s after it, the offset plot with a moving cursor and the 0.5 s FTTI band, and the events: fault: hard-over: torque ramped 15 per frame to 1500 at 0.00 s; driver cue: 0.2 m drift at 1.14 s; body on the 3.7 m lane line at 1.77 s; driver starts to correct at 2.64 s.
svg.text: HE-01.2 · ASIL C (D if AOU-01, AOU-02 fail)
Lateral departure into an adjacent vehicle or barrier
road straightened; the car keeps its place, the road moves
body on the 3.7 m lane line (0.96 m)
